name: @pdx-ts/reference-spike
description: Quarantined Authoring Reference spike. Never published, never promoted, deleted on a fail verdict.
_why_build_viewer: The viewer's build script is named build:viewer, not build, because the repository root runs `npm run build --workspaces --if-present`. A spike that joined the release build would be exactly the root integration the design rules out.
_why_mod_import: `#mod` is the alias a scaffolded project gives its own `src/mod.ts`, and a Recipe renders `import { mod } from "#mod"` into every file it writes. Declaring it here is what lets the technology page's Recipe story be the Recipe's exact bytes — compiled and synthesized like every other story — instead of a copy with the import rewritten.
